title: Fix 3 bugs in rust_boxed_errors
description: Brownfield Rust dirty scenario: parse_number, sum_lines, and validate_username each have a bug. Fix them so all 7 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/lib.rs so all 7 tests pass.

  fn parse_number(s: &str):
    — missing .trim() — fails on whitespace-padded strings
    — fix: change s.parse() to s.trim().parse()

  fn sum_lines(path: &Path):
    — subtracts (total -= ...) instead of adding
    — fix: change to total += parse_number(line)?

  fn validate_username(name: &str):
    — uses && instead of || in length check — impossible condition
    — fix: change 'name.len() < 3 && name.len() > 20' to 'name.len() < 3 || name.len() > 20'

Do not modify the test code.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: validate_username uses || not && in length check
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
